contexts.text: Where they are gathered together in the Lord's name () = those who are in the doctrine of faith concerning love and charity, thus who are in love and charity.
The congregation of Jehovah () = Heaven.
The congregation in general, which is commonly called the Church...
Let them gather all the food () = all things which are of use. To gather = to bring together and preserve.
He gathered all the food of the seven years () = the preservation of truth adjoined to good...
One congregation (of the Church) says it is true, another says it is false...

Gather yourselves together () = that they should arrange themselves in order. To be gathered together = to be ordered; for in the spiritual sense to be gathered together is nothing else, because truths and goods cannot be gathered together unless they are also ordered... As soon as Angels or Spirits are gathered together they are at once disposed into order as of themselves, and thus constitute a heavenly Society...

Into their congregation, my glory, be not thou united () = not to want to be conjoined with the falsities of their thought... The falsities of thought are signified by congregation; for congregation, like multitude, is predicated of truths, and in the opposite sense, of falsities. AE 443:6.
The congregation of the people () = those who are in the truths which are of intelligence; for congregation is predicated of truths.
The gathering of the waters () = where falsities are together.
To gather () = to collect.

The whole assembly of the congregation of Israel () = by all in general who are of the Spiritual Church. By the assembly of the congregation are signified the truths of good which are with those of that Church; for congregation is predicated of truth, and assembly, of good. AC 8413.
Standard = gathering together.
To be gathered together () = to bring themselves together.
To gather together that assembly () = the enumeration of all.
The combinations, confasciculations, and groupings from which the organs and viscera arise...
The first degree, by confasciculations or conglobations, in a word, by congregations, produces the second... DLW 184:end.
Their congregates are held together by the circumpressure of the atmospheres...
The second forms are congregates of these...
Come, and gather yourselves together to the supper of the great God () = a calling and convocation to the New Church and to conjunction with the Lord.
To gather them together to war () = to excite them against those who worship the Lord and live according to His commandments. AE 1003. AE 1010.
He disposes both into Societies and congregations according to all the varieties of their love... In like manner the congregations in Hell...
To love a number of men in a congregation, is to love the neighbour more than to love one person of the congregation.
All of the same religion are arranged into Societies... In Hell into congregations...
In the congregation of the saints ().
I will gather them, because I will redeem them () = the dissipation of falsities, and reformation through truths...
Congregations in the Word have a similar signification to people, namely, those who are in spiritual truths; and abstractedly, those truths themselves.
The congregation of great nations from the land of the north () = direful evils rising up from Hell.
The congregation of the people of God () = consultation about the things of the Church.
To gather together the elect from the four winds () = the establishment of a new Church.
That the good are to be preserved, is meant by the gathering of the wheat into the barn (). AE 911:5.
To gather all nations and tongues () has a similar signification to the gathering of the elect from the four winds. To gather to receive to Himself those who are His.
The kingdoms of the nations gathered together () = the falsities of evil which they have made in order to cohere.
The congregation () = false doctrinal things.
Thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered () = a religion without any coherence and restoration.
To stand in the congregation, and cry () = among truths, and yet in falsities.
The congregation () = their conjunction and orderly arrangement in forms, such as there are with the man of the Church in the understanding.
(The state of those who are merely natural, when they are in company.)
